nl: 客户拜访跟进（vue2 / Element UI）：查询有客户名称、跟进人（下拉数据来自 /api/staff 接口）；表格展示客户名称、跟进人、拜访方式、下次拜访时间、状态；表格上方左侧「新增跟进」、右侧「批量导出」；支持新增、编辑、删除；新增、编辑、删除按钮需要权限码 visit:add、visit:edit、visit:remove；查询表单标签宽度 90px。
nlEn: Customer visit follow-up (vue2 / Element UI): query by customer name and follower (the follower dropdown data comes from the /api/staff endpoint); the table shows customer name, follower, visit method, next visit time, and status; above the table "New Follow-up" is on the left and "Batch Export" on the right; supports add, edit, and delete; the add, edit, and delete buttons require permission codes visit:add, visit:edit, visit:remove; the query form label width is 90px.
notes: vue2 目标 + 四维：apiParams(跟进人下拉) + formLayout(labelWidth) + tableBtns(左/右) + permissions。
